scientific_decision.justification: Upstream microtrait.hmmdb.gz release omits aphA and phoN, but includes extra model phbB. Total assayed 1,830 database models includes extra phbB, so assayed required-rule HMMs are 1,829 of 1,831; raw outputs unchanged. Exactly 1,829 of 1,831 required rule HMMs are assayed. Total unique HMM models in combined databases is 1,830. No invented or non-official models are substituted. Official raw tables are retained verbatim.
scientific_decision.interpretation_safe_rule: Absence of phosphatase cannot be definitively asserted when phoA and phoD are 0, because aphA and phoN were unassayed. When phoA or phoD is positive (>0), presence is confirmed.
